g.text: D2 clamps motor and hot-plug spikes below the 40 V

g.desc: D2 clamps motor and hot-plug spikes below the 40 V

g.text: absolute maximum of U2 and U6. C6: 24 V bulk.

g.desc: absolute maximum of U2 and U6. C6: 24 V bulk.

g.text: Link to the HMI board: RS-485 over an RJ11 cord

g.desc: Link to the HMI board: RS-485 over an RJ11 cord

g.text: Q1 / Q2 / Q3 (BSS138, Vgs(th) <= 1.5 V) replace the TXS0104E. 5 V side: SCL, SDA, TOF_INT (PB4 / PCINT4).

g.desc: Q1 / Q2 / Q3 (BSS138, Vgs(th) <= 1.5 V) replace the TXS0104E. 5 V side: SCL, SDA, TOF_INT (PB4 / PCINT4).

g.text: Sensor side (2.8 V): SCL, SDA and GPIO1 of U3. A low from the MCU stays under the 0.6 V VIL of the sensor.

g.desc: Sensor side (2.8 V): SCL, SDA and GPIO1 of U3. A low from the MCU stays under the 0.6 V VIL of the sensor.

g.text: ENA left open: internal 1.5 MOhm pull-up

g.desc: ENA left open: internal 1.5 MOhm pull-up

g.text: only for cords over ~5 m (then R14 / R17 = 680R).

g.desc: only for cords over ~5 m (then R14 / R17 = 680R).

g.text: J4 pin-out (6P6C, straight or reversed cord):

g.desc: J4 pin-out (6P6C, straight or reversed cord):

g.text: A reversed cord only swaps A and B: the HMI board detects it.

g.desc: A reversed cord only swaps A and B: the HMI board detects it.

g.text: Never plug J4 into a telephone wall socket.

g.desc: Never plug J4 into a telephone wall socket.

g.text: Motor supply: shunt + INA226, switch, driver connectors

g.desc: Motor supply: shunt + INA226, switch, driver connectors

g.text: INA226: I2C address 0x40 (A0 = A1 = GND), alert on PE6.

g.desc: INA226: I2C address 0x40 (A0 = A1 = GND), alert on PE6.

g.text: R23 2 mOhm: +-41 A full scale, 1.25 mA resolution, 0.34 W at 13 A.

g.desc: R23 2 mOhm: +-41 A full scale, 1.25 mA resolution, 0.34 W at 13 A.

g.text: Kelvin-connect Vin+ / Vin- right at the R23 pads. +24V / MOTOR_24V / MOTOR_SW:

g.desc: Kelvin-connect Vin+ / Vin- right at the R23 pads. +24V / MOTOR_24V / MOTOR_SW:

g.text: copper for 15 A (pours, or >= 5 mm in 1 oz).

g.desc: copper for 15 A (pours, or >= 5 mm in 1 oz).

g.text: 24 V supply input, 24 A screw terminal

g.desc: 24 V supply input, 24 A screw terminal

g.text: L1 22 uH, C7 + C8 2 x 47 uF: f_LC ~ 4.7 kHz.

g.desc: L1 22 uH, C7 + C8 2 x 47 uF: f_LC ~ 4.7 kHz.

g.text: C4 / R9 / C12 / C11: crossover 14-27 kHz,

g.desc: C4 / R9 / C12 / C11: crossover 14-27 kHz,

g.text: MOTOR_PWR high: Q5 on (Vgs -12 V). R22 keeps it off in reset.

g.desc: MOTOR_PWR high: Q5 on (Vgs -12 V). R22 keeps it off in reset.

g.text: C21 / R20: ~15 ms soft start. Cut only with the PWM at 0.

g.desc: C21 / R20: ~15 ms soft start. Cut only with the PWM at 0.

g.text: J6: DIR, PWM and logic GND

g.desc: J6: DIR, PWM and logic GND
